resumen: Although / even though + cláusula completa (sujeto + verbo): Although it was late, we kept working.
Despite / in spite of + sustantivo o -ing, nunca despite of: Despite the rain…, In spite of feeling tired…; con cláusula: despite the fact that…
However / nevertheless son adverbios: conectan con la oración anterior (tras punto o punto y coma) y llevan coma: It was cheap; however, it broke.
Whereas / while contrastan dos hechos dentro de la misma oración: I love cities, whereas my brother prefers the countryside.
Causa: because + cláusula; because of, due to y owing to + sustantivo: owing to the fog.
Resultado: therefore, consequently y as a result son adverbios con coma (As a result, prices rose.); as a result of va + sustantivo.
Propósito: to / in order to / so as to + infinitivo (negativo: so as not to); so that + sujeto + can/could: so that I can rest.
Adición: moreover, furthermore e in addition abren oración; as well as, besides e in addition to van con sustantivo o -ing: besides being cheap.

preguntas.q: ___ it was raining, we went for a walk in the park.
preguntas.x: Although va seguido de una cláusula completa (sujeto + verbo): although it was raining. Despite necesita sustantivo o -ing (despite the rain), y however une dos oraciones separadas, no introduce una subordinada.

preguntas.q: Our flight was delayed ___ the fog.
preguntas.x: Because of + sustantivo: because of the fog. Because solo necesita una cláusula (because it was foggy), y so introduce un resultado, no una causa.

preguntas.q: I'm saving money ___ buy a new laptop.
preguntas.x: Para expresar propósito con un verbo se usa to + infinitivo: to buy. For va con sustantivos (for a new laptop), y for to buy es un calco de «para comprar».

preguntas.q: Marta plays the guitar ___ the piano.
preguntas.x: As well as = «además de» y va delante de un sustantivo: the guitar as well as the piano. As well, also y too son adverbios y no pueden unir dos sustantivos de este modo.

preguntas.q: The match went ahead ___ the terrible weather.
preguntas.x: Despite + sustantivo, sin of: despite the terrible weather. Despite of mezcla despite con in spite of, y although necesitaría una cláusula (although the weather was terrible).

preguntas.q: The hotel was expensive. ___, the service was excellent.
preguntas.x: However es un adverbio que conecta con la oración anterior, ya cerrada con punto, y va seguido de coma. Although y even though son conjunciones que introducen una cláusula dentro de la misma oración, y despite necesita un sustantivo.

preguntas.q: My brother loves crowded cities, ___ I prefer quiet villages.
preguntas.x: Whereas une dos cláusulas para contrastar dos hechos: he loves cities, whereas I prefer villages. However no puede unir dos oraciones con una simple coma (necesita punto o punto y coma), y despite e in spite of exigen sustantivo.

preguntas.q: I'm leaving work early ___ I can catch the six o'clock train.
preguntas.x: So that + sujeto + can/could expresa propósito con una cláusula completa: so that I can catch…. In order to y so as to van seguidos directamente del infinitivo (in order to catch), nunca de un sujeto.

preguntas.q: Lucía wrote down every step ___ forget how to configure the router.
preguntas.x: El propósito negativo se forma con so as not to o in order not to + infinitivo: so as not to forget. For not calca «para no», y so that necesitaría sujeto y verbo: so that she wouldn't forget.

preguntas.a: Despite feeling nervous, she gave a brilliant talk.
d: Despite she felt nervous, she gave a brilliant talk.
Although her nerves, she gave a brilliant talk.
Despite of feeling nervous, she gave a brilliant talk.
preguntas.x: Despite (sin of) va con sustantivo o -ing: despite feeling nervous. Although necesita una cláusula (although she felt nervous), así que despite she felt y although her nerves mezclan las dos estructuras.

preguntas.q: Choose the sentence that means the same as: “The roads were icy, so the school closed.”
preguntas.a: The school closed owing to the icy roads.
d: The school closed in spite of the icy roads.
The school closed owing to the roads were icy.
The roads were icy owing to the school closed.
preguntas.x: Owing to (como due to o because of) + sustantivo expresa la causa: owing to the icy roads. Con una cláusula haría falta because u owing to the fact that, e in spite of expresa contraste, no causa.

preguntas.q: The course is free. ___, you get a certificate when you finish.
preguntas.x: Moreover (como furthermore o in addition) es un adverbio que añade información al inicio de una nueva oración, seguido de coma. As well as necesita un sustantivo o -ing detrás (as well as being free), y besides of no existe.

preguntas.q: Choose the sentence that means the same as: “Tom is very outgoing, but his sister is quite shy.”
preguntas.a: While Tom is very outgoing, his sister is quite shy.
d: In spite of Tom is very outgoing, his sister is quite shy.
Tom is very outgoing, therefore his sister is quite shy.
Tom is very outgoing as well as his sister is quite shy.
preguntas.x: While (o whereas) une dos cláusulas que contrastan: While Tom is outgoing, his sister is shy. Therefore indica consecuencia, in spite of no admite una cláusula y as well as no une oraciones completas.

preguntas.q: The software was outdated and, ___, it had to be replaced.
preguntas.x: Therefore es un adverbio de resultado y puede ir entre comas en medio de la oración: and, therefore, it had to be replaced. However marca contraste, pero aquí la relación es de causa y efecto; because introduce la causa, no el resultado, y as a result of necesita un sustantivo detrás.

preguntas.q: In addition ___ a degree, you'll need at least two years' experience.
preguntas.x: En in addition to, to es preposición (no parte de un infinitivo), así que va con sustantivo o -ing: in addition to having. El error típico es in addition to have.

preguntas.q: The company lost several important clients ___ the data breach.
preguntas.x: As a result of + sustantivo indica la causa: as a result of the data breach. As a result, consequently y therefore son adverbios que conectan oraciones y no pueden ir seguidos directamente de un sustantivo.

preguntas.a: The plan was risky; nevertheless, the board approved it.
d: The plan was risky, nevertheless the board approved it.
The plan was risky. Despite, the board approved it.
Although the plan was risky, but the board approved it.
preguntas.x: Nevertheless (como however) es un adverbio: entre dos oraciones independientes pide punto o punto y coma delante y coma detrás. Despite nunca va solo, y although no se combina con but en la misma oración.

preguntas.q: ___ being cheaper, the new model uses less energy.
preguntas.x: Besides puede funcionar como preposición (= in addition to) y va con sustantivo o -ing: besides being cheaper. Moreover y furthermore son adverbios que abren una oración nueva, e in addition necesitaría to: in addition to being.
